transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Welcome to S-Net digital television and entertainment technical support. My name is Toby. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Toby. I am having a terrible, confusing time trying to watch television on our S-Net TV Box Pro. Yesterday evening the television screen showed an automatic software update message, and ever since then, the small black remote control handset has stopped working completely! No matter what button I press, the television does not respond at all!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that remote control connection issue for you. Before we diagnose the Bluetooth pairing link, may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 42 Highfield Lane, Southampton, SO17 1RN. And my security question answer is my first pet's name, Barnaby.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that verifies the television subscriber profile. What model is the TV box?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is the TV Box Pro. Toby, I am eighty-three years old, I live alone, and my television is my entire world and my only companion in the evenings! I suffer from severe osteoarthritis in both hands and swollen knuckles, so trying to grip tiny buttons is agonizingly painful! When the television froze last night, I sat alone in total silence in the dark for four hours, feeling utterly helpless, confused, and discarded by modern technology! All I wanted was to watch the evening news and the classical music concert, but everything was pitch black! I am so distressed and exhausted trying to figure out these modern gadgets!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how deeply frustrating and distressing it is when severe arthritis in your hands makes handling small remote buttons painful, and sitting in silence without your evening news and music when the television is your primary companion is awful, so let us take this step by step together and get your remote control working easily.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Toby, I truly appreciate your patience with an old pensioner.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I understand correctly, following the automatic software update yesterday evening, your TV Box Pro remote control became unpaired, leaving the television completely unresponsive to all button commands, and we need to re-pair the Bluetooth connection or provide an accessible replacement handset. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what happened and what I need help with.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you press the Home button at the top of the remote control, do you see a small light flash at the very tip of the handset?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When I press Home, a tiny amber light blinks three times and then goes out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Three amber blinks indicates the remote handset is in Bluetooth search mode but has lost its secure encryption link to the TV Box Pro.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do we get it reconnected to the box?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you standing within one metre of the TV Box Pro with a clear line of sight to the front glass panel?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am standing right in front of the television cabinet about three feet away.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We need to press and hold down the '7' and '9' number keys simultaneously for five continuous seconds until the LED flashes purple twice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me see... where are the seven and nine buttons... my fingers are trembling... I am pressing seven... but my thumb keeps slipping off the nine...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Use two separate hands, place the remote flat on the table, and press both buttons firmly together.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am trying Toby, I really am, but my knuckles are so stiff today... the light is still flashing amber, it didn't turn purple...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Any complete idiot knows how to press a Bluetooth pairing button! It's not rocket science, just hold down two numbers!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How dare you call me an idiot! I am an eighty-three-year-old retired school headmaster with crippling joint disease! I have never been spoken to with such vile disrespect in my entire life! You should be ashamed of yourself!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, that was unprofessional. Let us move to an alternative pairing method directly on the front panel of the box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will be making a formal complaint to the executive office about that insult. What is this alternative method?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On the right-hand side of the TV Box Pro casing, there is a small physical button labeled 'Pair Remote'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looking on the side of the box... yes, I can feel a raised rectangular button labeled 'Pair Remote'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press that physical Pair Remote button once, and hold the remote handset directly against the box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing the button on the side... holding remote against the casing... the screen just popped up saying 'Remote Connected Successfully'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Physical proximity pairing forces hardware cryptographic handshake without requiring two-key keypress combos.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The television channels are changing normally now! I can see the classical concert channel!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct ownership of upgrading your equipment and dispatch an S-Net Easy-Grip Large Button Accessibility Remote free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An Easy-Grip remote with larger buttons would be wonderful for my arthritic hands.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously ergonomic tactile handsets prevent recurrent dexterous strain during daily channel navigation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It will make watching television so much more comfortable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have created hardware dispatch order ACC-REM-882194 for the Large Button accessibility handset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dispatch order ACC-REM-882194 noted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The accessibility remote features high-contrast white keys on a matte black background with double-sized channel and volume rockers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Double-sized rockers will be much easier for my swollen thumb joints.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The handset also comes pre-paired from our warehouse so no button combos are needed upon delivery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a huge relief that it works right out of the packaging.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Royal Mail tracked delivery is scheduled to deliver the accessibility package on Wednesday morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will watch for the postman on Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the TV Box Pro standby sleep timer settings so the box does not un-pair during power-save mode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Under Settings, Standby Mode is currently set to 'Energy Saver'. Should I change that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Change Standby Mode to 'Smart Standby' to keep the Bluetooth antenna active in low-power idle mode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Clicking Smart Standby... saved successfully.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Smart Standby prevents the remote connection from dropping out overnight.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will prevent the issue from happening again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your TV package subscription channels to make sure the classical music bouquet is in your favorites.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Channel 710 BBC Radio 3 and Channel 504 Classical Arts are in my top favorites.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Both channels are fully authorized on your subscriber smartcard profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The sound quality is crystal clear through my hearing aids.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also register your profile on the Priority Telecare Register for accessible customer support.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, that will ensure future representatives know about my physical disabilities.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have marked your account with Accessibility Flag B for physical dexterity support.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for adding that marker.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us verify your contact telephone number for delivery notifications.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My landline is 023 8096 0411.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the accessibility remote dispatch reference is ACC-REM-882194 scheduled for Wednesday delivery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, ACC-REM-882194 for Wednesday. That is correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The shipment tracking number will be logged in your account portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait Toby, what should I do with this old remote once the new one arrives? Do I need to send it back in a special...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just throw it away. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Toby? He disconnected while I was speaking! First called me an idiot, now hangs up! Appalling!
